title: Treatise of the Pressing Point
summary: Trains a qi-fed thrust that is held on the target and pressed in after contact, for students past the first forms.

title: The Haft-Cycle Spear Course
summary: A graded course in cycling the shaft through the hands so thrusts and parries follow without a pause.

title: Workbook of Stepping Spear Combinations
summary: Gives sequences of two and three steps joined to thrusts, so that students learn to attack through movement.

title: A Drill-Master's Guide to Binding the Shaft
summary: Teaches how to catch, hold and steer an opposing shaft with one's own so the opponent is controlled.

title: Principles of the Guarded Lunge
summary: Shows how to lunge deep into the opponent while keeping the shaft in position to guard the retreat.

title: The Spear and the Hanging Guard
summary: A treatise on the guard with the point held high and the shaft slanting down, and the strikes that spring from it.

title: Canon of the Sweeping Haft
summary: A school canon built on wide sweeps of the shaft that strike, clear and open the line for the point.

title: Spearmanship for the Qi-Fed Soldier
summary: Trains a qi-aided soldier to work in a line, holding a point steady and thrusting on a count.

title: The Feint and the Point: A Middle Course
summary: Treats the false thrust and the true thrust together, teaching when to threaten and when to commit.

title: Handbook of Counter-Thrust and Return Step
summary: Teaches how to meet an attack with a thrust that answers it and a step that carries the body clear.
